content.text:
I found the real cause and fixed it; my last change was aimed at the wrong thing.

**What was wrong:** when the input is empty, the send button is disabled, and a disabled button is drawn at 15% opacity. The line between its two halves didn't fade with it and stayed at full strength. So in the usual resting state, a bright line cut across a faded button. Making that line's colour slightly lighter or darker, as I did last time, couldn't help.

**The fix:** in `src/chat_input.rs`, the line now fades to the same 15% whenever the chevron half is disabled. That covers an empty input, the compiled-prompt preview and editing a queued prompt. When the button is active, the line stays a barely different shade of the button's colour.

The spec in `spec/scope/prompt-mode/chat-input/index.pi` now says the line fades with the half it borders. The colour test also checks that the disabled line is faded. The chat input tests pass, clippy is clean, and the spec builds. I haven't looked at it in the running app, so please check the empty-input state.
